book.name: Lipe Mundurumu Yema
book.title: LIPE MUNDURUMU YEMA Yesusini “Nanga Kongonomo Tenjipai.” Nimbe Lipe Mundurumu Yemanga Bokumu

content: Kanu kinie Pollone kanjolloma nemo nemo nimbe kanopalie nimbendo: “Angokeme, na Pulu Yemo kanopa molopili yuni “Tei.” nilimo mele andopo telio kinie ‘Na Pulu Yemone kanopa keri kanolemo ulu te tepo kenjikiru lemo.’ nimbu naa pilirindu.” nirimu.
Aku nirimu kinie Pulu Yemo popo tonjiringi ye aili olandopa* Ananayasini Pollo kinie nondoko angiliringi yemando nimbendo: “Yu kerena laruwe tai.” nirimu.

Ananayasini aku nirimu kinie Pollone yundu ⸤ungu iku topalie⸥ nimbendo: “Ulke kengelena peneme kake teli kanjíngimu,* nu Pulu Yemone laruwe tomba. ‘Pulu Yemone “Teai.” nimbe mane silimo mele pilkulie na kote tenjembo.’ konopu lekeno nakolo “Na laruwe tai.” nikinumunge nu nunu Pulu Yemonga ungu manema pulue tokono lemo.” nirimu.
Pollo kinie nondoko angiliringi yemane ningindu: “Nu Pulu Yemo popo tonjili ye aili olandopa kake telimu pipili naa tekemona ungu taka tonjikinuye?” niringi.
Pollone nimbendo: “Angokeme, yu kanu ye nomimu kanopo imbi naa sipulie aku sipu nindu. Ungu te Pulu Yemonga bokuna molemo mele i sipe:

content.text: ‘Enenga ye nomimu ungu taka naa tonjengi.’*

content: nimbe molemo, akumu na pilio. ‘Yu aku ye nomimu molemo.’ nimbu kanopo imbi silkenje yu ungu taka naa tonjilke.” nirimu.

Pollone aku nimbelie nirimumuni, yu yuyu konopu kimbu sipelie ‘I kanjollo ye mare Sadusi yema, mare Parisi yema lemo.’* konopu lepalie, yuni nimbendo: “Angokeme, na Parisi yemo moliola. Tara Parisi yemo molorumula. ‘Yamboma kolkolie lomboroko ola molonge.’ nimbu pilio. Na aku sipu konopu leliomonga na kote tenjikimili.” nirimu.
Yuni aku nirimu pilkulie, Parisi yema kinie Sadusi yema kinie kerepali ningulie, kanjollo yema talape talo mele moloringi.

(Kerepali niringimunge pulumu i sipe: Sadusi yemane ningindu: “Yambo te kolopalie lomboropa ola naa molomba. Angelloma kinie minime kinie kuruma kinie naa molemele.” niringi nakolo Parisi yemane ningindu: “Yamboma lomboroko ola molonge. Angelloma kinie minime kinie kuruma kinie paa sike molemele.” niringi.)

Aku ningu piliringi mele Pollone pilipelie ungu nirimu pilkulie kanjolloma mumindili kolko tondolo kerepali ningu anju yando ungu panjiringi. Pulu Yemonga ungu manemanga puluma pilku mane siringi ye mare,* ene Parisi yema moloringi, kanumane ola angilku tondolo mundukulie ningindu: “I yemo ‘Ulu te tepa naa kenjimu.’ nimbu pilkimulu. Yu mini tene molo angello tene ungu te nimbe simunje?” niringi.

Ene tondolo irinele teko paa mumindili koloringine Romo ami ye nomimuni mini wale mundupelie, ‘Pollo anju yando kundukulie yu toko konjingí.’ konopu lepalie, ami yemando nimbendo: “Ene maniendo puku, yu tondolo munduku liku mengo ulkendo wai.” nirimu.

Opalikundu ipulueli Ailimu* Pollo molorumuna nondopa ombalie nimbendo: “Nu pipili naa kolko toembo toko moloi. Kinié ya kolea aili Jerusalleme nanga ungumu ningu sinu, aku siku mele nuni kolea aili Romo** ungumu ningu sini lemo.” nirimu.
Ipulueli ou Juda ye ailimene ungu te ningu panjikulie ningindu: “Pollo topo konjemili. Ou naa topo konjipulie, no kinie langi naa nomolo.” ningu mi leringi.
Pollo tongendo langi niringi ye tu paono mele moloringi.

Aku siku ningu panjikulie, ene Pulu Yemo popo tonjiringi ye ailime kinie Juda yambomanga tapu yema kinie* moloringine pukulie ningindu: “Olio ungu te nimbu panjipu mi lemulu mele i sipe: “Pollo ou naa topolie nimulúmuni, langi wallo kolte kepe paa naa nomolo.” nímulu.

Aku temulu kene kanjolloma kinie enene ami ye nomimu molemona ningu mundukulie kolo toko yundu “Pollo ungu mare altopa omba nimbe sipili. Puluma paa mimi sipu piliemili, memba maniendo opili.” niei.” niringi. “Pe yu mengo onge kinie ene molongena ou naa opili aulkena nokopo molopo yu topo konjimulú.” niringi.
Nakolo Pollo kemulunge malone, enene yunge kepa tongendo langi niringi mele pilipelie, yu ami yema peringi ulkena Pollo molorumuna pupe nimbe sirimu.
Kanu kinie Pollone ami ye wane anderete nokorumu ye te “Oi.” nimbelie yundu nimbendo: “I kango yemo enenga ye nomimu ungu te pelemomo nimbe sipili, yu molemona mengo pani.” nirimu.

Pollone aku nirimu pilipelie kanu yemo yunge ye nomimu molorumuna kango yemo memba purumu. Memba pupelie ami ye nomimundu nimbendo: “Ya ka ulke pelemo ye ‘Pollo’ nili kanumuni nando “Oi.” nimbelie nimbendo: “I kango yemo nunge ye ailimundu ungu te nimbé kene yu molemona mengo pui.” nimuna membo okoro.” nirimu.
Ye nomi kanumuni kangomo ki ambolopa memba tenga lupe pupe eltelte molkololie yu walsipelie nimbendo: “Nuni nambolka unguri ninindu onuye?” nirimu.

Kangomone yundu nimbendo: “Juda ye ailimene ‘Opali nu walsiku, “Ene Pollo ungu mare altopa omba nimbe sipili, puluma paa mimi sipu piliemili, nuni olio kanjolloma molomolona mengo maniendo wani.” kolo topo aku sipu niemili.’ ningu ou ningu panjíngi.

Nakolo enenga ungu ningí mele naa pilieni! Enenga ye tu paono mele “Olio ou Pollo topo naa konjipulie langi kepe no kepe naa nomolo.” ningu mi lengi. Nuni “E.” ningu mengo oni kinie toko konjingindu aulkena nokoko molonge.” nirimu.
Ami ye nomimuni kango yemondo nimbendo: “Kinié na ningu sikinu mele anju yambo tendo lupe paa naa ningu sikulie we pui.” nirimu.

Kangomo purumu kinie ami ye nomimuni ami ye wane anderete wane anderete ningulu nokoringili yetolo “Wale.” nimbelie nimbendo: “Elte ami ye tu anderete kinie kongi otena andolemele ami ye tere paono tene kinie tólo mengo andolemele ami ye tu anderete kinie liku maku tokolie, kinié ipulueli ena nani killoko Pollo mengo kolea aili Sisaria pangi.

Pollo aulkena tonge kene yu kongi otena molopili kolea Pellisitane disiriki Romo gapomano ye Pillikisi kolea aili Sisaria molemona mengo pangi. Yu aulkena ulu te wendo naa opili nokoko konjiku mengo pangi.” nirimu.
Aku nimbelie ye nomimuni ‘Pillikisi puku siengi.’ nimbe pepá te topalie nimbendo:
‘Na Lodiasi LLisiasini i pepámo

content.text: nu gapomano ye paa aili Pillikisi topo sikiru.

content: I ye mengo okomelemo Juda yambomane

content.text: ambolko liku toko konjingí tengi nakolo
na kinie nanga ami yema kinie ombolie
‘Yu Romo yemo.’ nimbu pilipulie na kinie
ami yema olione yu wendo lipu membo púmulu.

content: “Yu tepa kenjimu.” ningu

content.text: enenga kanjollo yema molongine membo pundu.

content: Membo pupulie pilindu kinie

content.text: aku siku níngi pilindu. Yu kote tenjikulie

content: Kanu kinie pe yu tongendo langi níngi mele

content.text: yambo tene na nimbe simu pilipulie, tamburembu
ami yemando “Nu molenona mengo pai.” nindu.

content: nimbe yu pepá te topa aku sipe nirimu.
Kanu kinie ami ye nomimuni “Teai.” nirimu mele tengendo ipulueli Pollo liku mengo Andipatirisi taonona puku pekolie niringimuni,
ipulueli ou ‘Kongi otena andoli ami yema Pollo lkisiku mengo pangi.’ ningu ami ye wema kelko yando oringi.
Otena andoli ami yema Pollo mengo kolea aili Sisaria suku ongolie, gapomano ye ailimu molorumuna Pollo mengo pukulie pepámo siringi.
Gapomano ye ailimuni pepámo lipe kanopalie, Pollo walsipelie nimbendo: “Nunge poropinji tenaye?” nirimu. Pollone nimbendo: “Na kolea Sillisia poropinji yemo.” nirimu kinie pilipelie nirimumuni,

yuni nimbendo: “Nu ‘kote tenjemili.’ nikimili yema onge kinie nunge kotemo piliembo.” nirimu. Aku nimbelie yuni nimbendo: “Pollo ye nomi kingi Erotene ou takopa perimu gapomano ulkena pepili mengo puku nokai.” nirimu.
